column1: # The files that may name the raw white — `--surface` in any spelling (check 20 in
# scripts/check-adherence.sh, M150). Everywhere else a control part reads `Ground`
# One line each: <path><TAB><reason>. The list only shrinks: a file that stops naming the white
# fails the check until its line goes. The reasons:
#   ground              the ground itself, and `Surface`, which sets it
#   page-ground         an app's page or door: the page is white
#   panel               a sheet, a modal, a detail panel: a page ground over the page
#   float               a menu, a list, a calendar, a toast, a bubble: white with its shadow (F7-15)
#   over-media          a chip, a thumbnail or a control drawn over a photograph or a map
#   paper               a document, a drawing sheet, a QR code's quiet zone, a brand specimen
#   full-screen-ground  a screen that is its own page
#   on-accent           a knob or a mark on the accent or the dark fill
#   measure             a contrast measurement against the paper
#   field               `FieldBox`'s focus gap: a field never sits in a tile
#   shimmer             a loading bar's shimmer: `Card`'s on the grey tile, `Kanban`'s on the page
#   deferred            owed by a row in docs/tasks/deferred.md
#   owed-T-SHELL        the shell's parts, moved by T-SHELL-001 and T-SHELL-008
